output.note: Fixed for every Higgsfield generation in both modes; never asked. Model-specific mapping lives in models/index.json (output_9x16_720p).

production.note: Analyze Mode (Recreate, Create, Free and Static): one production agent per video, at most max_parallel_agents at once; the ledger allows one job in flight per video lane and at most max_parallel_jobs per run (reference/production-agents.md). Edit Mode stays one video at a time.

capcut.note: Analyze Mode assembles every video as its own CapCut project DD_Mon_YYYY_vNN (reference/capcut-assembly.md). Same store and template as the capcut MCP server's CAPCUT_DRAFTS_DIR / CAPCUT_TEMPLATE_DRAFT.

short_text.note: The user, 2026-10-29: "our standard text size is 10 but when there's only few text to be placed then use font size 11". One size per video: 11 when at no moment more than max_words_at_once words are on screen (every text layer shown at that moment counted, so a caption split into two layers counts whole) and, at size 11, every line stays within max_line_width of the frame width; otherwise 10 for every text of the video. awl.py capcut-text-style counts and measures it (CapCut's System font; CapCut draws size s with a font of about 0.00575*s times the frame width, measured on CapCut's own renders) and reports it as 'sizing'. null turns the rule off.

text_style.preset: the user's chosen CapCut preset, learned from 03_Oct_2026_v09 on 2026-10-03 (white text, black outline 0.06); stored in 'learned'
text_style.note: Every CapCut text layer of every /analyze-with-loupe video uses this style: font System, size 10 (11 when the video has only a little text: 'short_text'), and the user's chosen preset in 'learned' (applied by awl.py capcut-text-style, run by capcut-repair after every save). 'locked': true = the user chose it for all videos (2026-10-03); never re-learn or replace it unless the user explicitly asks for a different preset (awl.py capcut-text-style --learn --replace). fill/stroke above are only the fallback look if 'learned' were ever missing.

static.note: Analyze -> Static (contract item 36): narrated still-image videos. No Higgsfield and no Loupe. Per PC, in the environment only: OPENAI_API_KEY (images by the API), AWL_IMAGE_PYTHON and AWL_IMAGE_ROOT (images by FLUX 3 Klein on the PC), AWL_TTS_PYTHON (+ AWL_TTS_DEVICE), AWL_MUSIC_PYTHON and AWL_MUSIC_ROOT (reference/static section 9).

limits.note: OpenAI's documented custom sizes for GPT Image 2 and 2.5 (API reference): both edges divisible by 16, the aspect between 1:3 and 3:1, no edge over 3840, the total pixels in this range; above 2560x1440 they are called experimental. size and quality above are the fallback when a run has no state.json -> static.format

prices_usd_per_1m.note: OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5 token prices; the cost a call reports is an estimate from its usage

klein.note: FLUX 3 Image Klein (distilled; int8, the build for GPUs without FP8 such as the RTX 30 series) made on this PC by scripts/image_worker.py in a private headless ComfyUI (AWL_IMAGE_PYTHON, AWL_IMAGE_ROOT; reference/static section 9). steps 16 and no CFG are the checkpoint's defaults; alpha is the reference code's timestep shift since 2026-10-17 (ComfyUI's own default is 6.93); upsample runs Black Forest Labs' prompt upsampler first (their model card: always, unless the prompt already is a full caption).
